The Kingdom of León [ a ] was an independent kingdom situated in the northwest region of the Iberian Peninsula . It was founded in 910, when the Christian princes of Asturias along the northern coast of the peninsula shifted their capital from Oviedo to the city of León . [ 3 ] The kings of León fought civil wars, wars against neighbouring kingdoms, and invasions by the Moors and the Vikings , to sustain their kingdom through a turbulent age.
